profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | MSCS @ USC
profile.summary:
Technology has the potential to empower people to create, optimize, and communicate to a scale that continues to evolve everyday. My passion is to be a part of this process, by implementing long lasting services that enable them to do so. 

I've developed features that have saved thousands at Snap, in addition to creating APIs that are consumed by more than 5000 users every day. I led a team at Hack4Impact to create a full stack web app in TypeScript for the NAACP. At the California Cybersecurity Institute, I implemented a JavaScript React app vulnerable to SQL injection to educate over 400 competitors across the US, Europe, and Australia about cybersecurity.

I'm always excited to work with other people, both in office and across the globe.

A list of my core skills include:
• Object Oriented Design & Programming
• REST & gRPC APIs
• Continuous Integration & Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)
• Agile Methodologies

Available to discuss new opportunities in the LA area or remote. Please contact me at nestor@nestormartinez.com

TECHNICAL SKILLS:
Languages: Java, Python, Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, HTML, CSS
Technologies: Git, UNIX, AWS, GCP, MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node), Docker, NoSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designing and building a new full stack web app from the ground up utilizing Typescript, React, and
Zustand in the frontend, powered by Firebase.

• Implemented 4s debounced saving to Firebase Firestore, reducing database calls by over 70%.
• Developed reusable frontend components for a consistent design on the authentication flow, integrating Google OAuth and a custom credential management system.
• Engineered a Google Docs style link sharing system, enhancing user collaboration and engagement.
• Architected backend models to ensure scalability and efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · API Development · Full-Stack Development · Software Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Monica, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Developed and modernized features from a legacy monolith Java service to new micro-services in Java and Go for Lenses and Account Reporting. Trained to be the point of contact for a Java service regarding day-to-day operations.

• Decreased build times 88%, saved costs, and eliminated technical debt by implementing and updating REST and gRPC API calls
• Implemented and deployed API response changes consumed by iOS and Android clients in service with over 3K queries per minute
• Optimized build time for a Gradle based project by 80%
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Go (Programming Language) · API Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.locationName: San Luis Obispo, California, United States

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Led a group of six student developers to create a web app for the NAACP using the MERN stack and
TypeScript. Coordinated with a product manager and the nonprofit for requirements.

• Performed code reviews on every feature developed, reducing errors and enforcing code styles
• Mentored developers in technical skills and project management
• Delegated tasks for developers in weekly sprints using GitHub Issues

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Implemented a web app with a team of seven using the MERN stack and JavaScript for another local
nonprofit.

• Designed and led features such as the creation of events, volunteer sign up, event searches and filters,
and admin reports, saving the nonprofit over $200 per year
• Worked directly with MongoDB to create multiple data schemas
• Utilizing Git, GitHub, and GitHub Issues for version control and development progress
• Voted MVP by my teammates

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: San Luis Obispo, California, United States
positions.description:
Strategized and developed a series of cybersecurity related programming challenges.

• Designed and implemented multiple cybersecurity activities in Python and JavaScript encountered by over 300 competitors across US, Europe, and Australia
• Hosted challenges and utilized AWS services such as EC2, Cognito, DynamoDB, and Lambda
• Tested AWS Lambda Functions using Python and Docker
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · JavaScript · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Web Development · Cybersecurity
